what: Graco makes pumps and spray equipment that move thick fluids: paint sprayers used by contractors, adhesive and sealant dispensers in factories, and lubrication systems.
customers: Painting contractors, industrial manufacturers and vehicle service shops, through distributors.
money: airless paint sprayers and texture equipment
adhesive, sealant and coating dispensing systems
moat: Professional painters standardise on Graco sprayers and buy Graco parts for them, and the distributors who serve those contractors stock accordingly.
risks: Revenue has been flat around $2.2B for four years
Contractor demand follows house painting and construction activity
23 times earnings for a business with little current growth
opportunities: A 23.3% net margin, among the highest of any industrial manufacturer, and $600M of free cash flow
$624M of cash against $28.5M of debt: effectively debt free
Analysts see about 18% upside and the dividend has been raised for nearly thirty years
watch: Contractor segment sales and the operating margin, which rarely falls below 25%.
